items.summary: Approve containment-only updates to existing execution reconciliation, failed-run containment, measurement, security evidence, and private-launch work. Reject new production, queue expansion, experiments, telemetry, spend, monetization, launch activity, unsupported financial claims, and external outreach. Preserve unknown attribution, revenue, ROI, margin, cost-to-learn, causal lift, and operational health. Owner decision remains required before any permission request is sent; private launch gates remain unchanged.

Material concerns: attribution is incomplete, revenue evidence covers one day with aggregate commission only, periods and costs do not reconcile, operational/security sweeps are unavailable, and existing failure and measurement backlogs are substantial. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero or use it to support financial or production claims.
